intro.title: SpaceLinx MES Documentation
intro.description: Welcome to the SpaceLinx MES (Manufacturing Execution System) documentation. This comprehensive system is designed for aerospace manufacturing and advanced production environments.

inventory/goodsInventory/editGood.title: 🧾 Edit Goods Inventory
inventory/goodsInventory/editGood.description: The Edit Goods Inventory page allows you to view and manage details of a specific goods item that already exists in your inventory.

inventory/goodsInventory/goodsInventory.title: 📦 Goods Inventory
inventory/goodsInventory/goodsInventory.description: The Goods Inventory page helps you manage and track all finished goods or stocked items available in your warehouse.

inventory/goodsInventory/newGood.title: 🧾 Create New Goods Inventory
inventory/goodsInventory/newGood.description: The Create Goods Inventory page allows you to add a new goods item to your inventory list.

inventory/partsInventory.title: ⚙️ Parts Inventory
inventory/partsInventory.description: The Parts Inventory page helps you track and manage the physical stock of each part across multiple locations and bins.

manufacturing/guides/guidedetails.title: 📘 Guide Details
manufacturing/guides/guidedetails.description: The Guide Details page gives a complete view of an individual guide.

manufacturing/guides/guides.title: 📖 Guides Module – User Guide
manufacturing/guides/guides.description: A Guide is a documented instruction, reference, or work procedure that helps teams follow standardized processes in manufacturing, assembly, or maintenance.

manufacturing/guides/newGuide.title: 📘 Create/Edit Guide
manufacturing/guides/newGuide.description: The Create/Edit Guide form allows users to add new guides or edit existing ones.

manufacturing/materialkits/materialkits.title: Material Kits
manufacturing/materialkits/materialkits.description: A Material Kit is a pre-packaged set of parts, tools, or components grouped together for a specific manufacturing task or work order.

manufacturing/materialkits/newMaterialKi.title: 📝 How to Create a New Material Kit
manufacturing/materialkits/newMaterialKi.description: The New Material Kit feature allows you to quickly create a kit by linking it to a part and location, specifying quantity, and optionally attaching an image.

manufacturing/products/newProduct.title: Create New Product
manufacturing/products/newProduct.description: The New Product page allows users to create a new product by linking it to an existing released part, associating it with a platform, adding a description, and optionally uploading an image.

manufacturing/products/products.title: 📦 Products Module – Overview
manufacturing/products/products.description: The Products module in SpaceLinx MES is designed to act as the core hub for manufacturing execution.

manufacturing/workorders/newWorkOrder.title: 📘 Create work order
manufacturing/workorders/newWorkOrder.description: The Create work order flyout allows users to create a new manufacturing/work order for a part or product.

manufacturing/workorders/workOrderDetail.title: 📋 Work Order Details
manufacturing/workorders/workOrderDetail.description: Once you select a Work Order from the list, you will be taken to the Work Order Details page.

manufacturing/workorders/workOrders.title: 📑 Work Orders
manufacturing/workorders/workOrders.description: A Work Order (WO) is a formal document that specifies tasks, operations, or production activities to be performed in a manufacturing process.

manufacturing/workorders/workOrderSteps.title: Work Order Steps
manufacturing/workorders/workOrderSteps.description: The Work Order Step page gives you a complete view of a specific Work Order, including its steps, progress, timing, materials, and BOM (Bill of Materials).

plm/eco/eco.title: Engineering Change Order (ECO)
plm/eco/eco.description: An Engineering Change Order (ECO) is a formal document used to propose, review, and approve changes to a part, product design, or process.

plm/eco/newEco.title: Create a New ECO
plm/eco/newEco.description: The New ECO (Engineering Change Order) screen allows you to record changes to existing parts or assemblies. It ensures every modification is documented with proper reasoning, priority, and impact analysis.

plm/machines/machines.title: Machines Module
plm/machines/machines.description: The Machines module in SpaceLinx MES is built to manage all production equipment and machinery within your manufacturing ecosystem. Machines are critical assets that require structured documentation, tracking, and categorization for seamless operations.

plm/machines/newMachine.title: 🏭 Create Machine
plm/machines/newMachine.description: The Create Machine form allows users to add new machines into the system.

plm/parts/bom.title: Bill of Materials (BOM) – Create & Manage
plm/parts/bom.description: The BOM Creation page allows you to attach child parts to a parent part, define their quantities, and manage relationships between parts. This is used to define how a product is built.

plm/parts/cloneBom.title: 📘 Clone BOM – User Guide
plm/parts/cloneBom.description: The Clone BOM (Bill of Materials) feature allows you to duplicate the structure of an existing BOM (all the parts and assemblies it contains) to another part in your system. This is particularly useful when you have multiple similar products or assemblies and want to reuse an existing BOM without manually creating it again.

plm/parts/editPart.title: Edit Part Flyout
plm/parts/editPart.description: The Edit Part Flyout allows you to view and update details of a selected part in the system.

plm/parts/newPart.title: Create a New Part
plm/parts/newPart.description: The New Part page allows you to create and register new parts in the system. Each part can include key details such as its type, name, measurement unit, manufacturing number, and an optional image.

plm/parts/parts.title: 📘 Parts Module – User Guide
plm/parts/parts.description: The Parts module helps you manage all the components, materials, and products used in your manufacturing process. From here, you can create, edit, organize, and track each part in your system.

plm/tools/newTool.title: 🛠️ Create Tool
plm/tools/newTool.description: The Create Tool form allows users to add a new tool into the system.

plm/tools/tools.title: Tools Module
plm/tools/tools.description: The Tools module in SpaceLinx MES is designed to manage all equipment, instruments, and devices that are essential for manufacturing operations. Every tool used in production needs to be properly recorded, categorized, and tracked to ensure accuracy, availability, and compliance.

procurement/goodsReceiptNote/editGoodsRe.title: Editing a Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
procurement/goodsReceiptNote/editGoodsRe.description: The Goods Receipt Note (GRN) is used to confirm the receipt of materials against a Purchase Order.

procurement/goodsReceiptNote/goodsreceip.title: Goods Receipts – Overview
procurement/goodsReceiptNote/goodsreceip.description: The Goods Receipts (GRN) page allows you to view, create, and manage goods receipt notes that record materials received against purchase orders.

procurement/goodsReceiptNote/newGoodsRec.title: Create Goods Receipt Note (New GRN)
procurement/goodsReceiptNote/newGoodsRec.description: The New GRN form allows you to create a new Goods Receipt Note (GRN) based on purchase orders.

procurement/purchaseorders/editPurchaseO.title: Purchase Order – Line Items
procurement/purchaseorders/editPurchaseO.description: The Line Items section is where you define the materials or services being purchased in a Purchase Order (PO). It includes controls for adding new items, applying discounts, setting tax options, selecting a currency, and reviewing the cost summary.

procurement/purchaseorders/newPurchaseOr.title: Create Purchase Order
procurement/purchaseorders/newPurchaseOr.description: The Create Purchase Order screen allows you to raise a new purchase order by filling in vendor, project, billing, shipping, and item details.

procurement/purchaseorders/purchaseOrder.title: Purchase Order Details
procurement/purchaseorders/purchaseOrder.description: The Purchase Order Details page allows you to view and manage a single purchase order (PO). Depending on your role and the PO status, you can perform actions such as editing, submitting, approving, rejecting, closing, or printing the PO.

procurement/purchaseorders/purchaseorder.title: Purchase Orders
procurement/purchaseorders/purchaseorder.description: A Purchase Order (PO) is a formal document issued by a buyer to a vendor or supplier, specifying the products or services they wish to purchase. It acts as a legal offer to buy and helps track orders from creation to delivery.

procurement/vendors/editVendor.title: 🏢 Edit Company
procurement/vendors/editVendor.description: The Edit Company page allows users to view and update existing company information, such as vendor or customer details, contact information, payment terms, and more.

procurement/vendors/newVendor.title: Create Company
procurement/vendors/newVendor.description: The Create Company page allows users to add new business entities such as Vendors, Customers, or Partners into the system.

procurement/vendors/vendors.title: Vendors
procurement/vendors/vendors.description: The Vendors page allows you to manage all the suppliers your organization works with.

spacelinx-mes.title: What is Spacelinx-MES?
spacelinx-mes.description: Spacelinx-MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is a platform designed to streamline and digitize manufacturing operations.

tutorial-basics/create-a-blog-post.description: Docusaurus creates a page for each blog post, but also a blog index page, a tag system, an RSS feed...

tutorial-basics/deploy-your-site.description: Docusaurus is a static-site-generator (also called Jamstack).

tutorial-basics/markdown-features.title: Markdown Features
tutorial-basics/markdown-features.description: Docusaurus supports Markdown and a few additional features.

tutorial-extras/manage-docs-versions.description: Docusaurus can manage multiple versions of your docs.
